EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT

This Employment Agreement is made on 1 April 2026 at Pune between Godavari Fintech Private Limited, having its registered office at 9, Senapati Bapat Road, Pune 411016 (the "Company") and Ms. Ishita Kulkarni, residing at Flat 302, Kothrud, Pune 411038 (the "Employee").

Clause 1: Appointment
The Company appoints the Employee as Senior Product Manager with effect from 1 April 2026. The Employee shall report to the Chief Product Officer.

Clause 2: Probation
The Employee shall be on probation for a period of 6 months. During probation either party may terminate the employment by giving 15 days notice.

Clause 3: Remuneration
The Employee shall be paid an annual cost to company of INR 32,00,000 (Rupees Thirty-Two Lakh only), subject to deduction of tax at source and contributions under the Employees' Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952.

Clause 4: Working Hours and Leave
The Employee shall work such hours as are necessary for the proper performance of her duties. The Employee is entitled to 24 days of paid leave in each calendar year, in addition to public holidays.

Clause 5: Confidentiality
The Employee shall not, during or after her employment, disclose any confidential information of the Company. Clause 5 shall survive termination of this Agreement.

Clause 6: Intellectual Property
All work product created by the Employee in the course of employment shall be the sole property of the Company, and the Employee hereby assigns all rights in such work product to the Company.

Clause 7: Non-Compete
For a period of 24 months after the termination of employment, the Employee shall not be employed by or associated with any business in India that competes with the Company.

Clause 8: Termination
After confirmation, either party may terminate the employment by giving 3 months written notice or salary in lieu thereof. The Company may terminate the employment without notice for misconduct.

Clause 9: Governing Law
This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of India and the courts at Pune shall have jurisdiction.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF the parties have signed this Agreement.

For Godavari Fintech Private Limited
Authorised Signatory

Ishita Kulkarni
Employee
